title: Updating SSO after a certificate rotation
snippet: Upload the new signing certificate under Settings > Security > SSO and re-download the metadata.

title: How plan changes are prorated
snippet: Upgrades mid-cycle are prorated daily; unused seats are credited to the new annual invoice.

title: Webhook retries and deduplication
snippet: Retries reuse the event id; deduplicate on the id and return 2xx within 10 seconds.

title: Endpoints after moving to the EU region
snippet: EU workspaces use api.eu.example.com; update DNS allowlists and regional base URLs.

title: Invoice currency and VAT corrections
snippet: Billing can reissue invoices in the contract currency with the correct VAT rate per country.

title: Import drops rows with special characters
snippet: Save the CSV as UTF-8 before import; rows with other encodings are skipped.

title: Transferring workspace ownership
snippet: An admin can transfer ownership of a deactivated user's workspace and shared folders.

title: SCIM provisioning and email case
snippet: Map the identity provider's immutable user id, not the email, to avoid duplicate users.

title: Partner credits on tax forms
snippet: Partner program credits appear on the 1099 under other income; request corrections from billing.

title: Resetting your password
snippet: Check spam for the reset email or ask an admin to send a new link.

title: Duplicate charges
snippet: Pending authorizations drop off in 3-5 days; settled duplicates are refunded by billing.

title: Upload size limits
snippet: Files up to 20 MB upload in the app; larger files need the desktop client.

title: Adding admins
snippet: Workspace owners can add admins under Settings > Members.

title: Export button in Firefox
snippet: Known issue fixed in 4.2; clear the cache after updating.

title: Frequent logouts on Android
snippet: Disable battery optimisation for the app to keep sessions alive.
